raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with a three-layered architecture. Layer 1 (Observe) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2 (Intelligence Layer) is a "Brain" that detects employee intent, the business value of tasks, and workflow "drift." Layer 3 (Execution Layer) is an "Agent Factory" that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. The system leverages existing foundation models and focuses on the "Work Graph" to optimize AI assistance mid-workflow.
raw.one_liner: Narma is an Enterprise Agentic Brain for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.
raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited by the vision of a single system that can continuously observe work, intelligently decide on AI interventions, and automatically build agents to deliver "Continuous AI lift" for AI-first companies.
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma differentiates itself by focusing on the "Work Graph" to identify where resources are being consumed and where AI can be injected mid-flow to assist, rather than developing new foundation models. Its three-layered architecture (Observe, Intelligence, Execution) and "Agent Factory" for automated agent generation and deployment are presented as key differentiators.

raw.thesis: Narma is developing an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to facilitate the adoption and scaling of AI automation. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: observing work patterns with desktop sensors (Layer 1), an "Intelligence Layer" that detects employee intent and business value of tasks while identifying workflow "drift" (Layer 2), and an "Agent Factory" which automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for high-ROI opportunities (Layer 3). These agents are built using existing foundation models. The system aims to provide "Continuous AI lift" by continuously observing work, deciding on AI interventions, and auto-building agents. This venture is for AI-first companies struggling to implement and scale AI effectively within their existing workflows. The problem it addresses is the difficulty in identifying valuable AI automation opportunities, proving their ROI, and seamlessly deploying them at scale. The founder's goal appears to be a growth startup, given the ambition to provide "Continuous AI lift" and automate agent generation. They are currently at the idea stage, as no artifacts or signals of development or traction are mentioned. Narma positions itself as a complementary solution to existing foundation models, by orchestrating their application within enterprise workflows, rather than replacing them. It precedes the widespread, seamless integration of AI into enterprise operations by providing the intelligence and execution layer for effective deployment.
